status: Occurrence-audit revision; audited body lines are listed in body_audit.json
provenance: Full-body annealing followed by manuscript comparison and the independent address formula. No archived key or published plaintext found.
cautions: Some short and long zigzags have been conflated: S/Z distinguish m/n.
A rounded cup-shaped null was sometimes labelled V (angular a).
Plain plus (g in the address) and angular four-like u/v require occurrence-level distinction.
Top-bar b and f differ; the address g label is not one consistently identified glyph.
DD and CE are compound shapes, not proof of two independently repeated cipher letters.
Clear-text word division and u/v modernization have not been added here.
K denotes the h-like null only; earlier labels sometimes conflated it with a five/d. Unaudited lines may retain such errors.
J is plain plus/g, distinguished from angular four/u. Unaudited lines retain their old plus labels.
U is rounded cup null, not angular V/a.
EX is the small cross before t in lextreme; x is contextual and its distinction from J/g needs further inventory checking.
G/open C is h, supported jointly by Jehan, charge and the proposed Arnhem; earlier x mapping withdrawn.
A_blotted in dih[u]itieme is an ink-heavy sign interpreted as u from its visible stem and date context; bracketed, grade M.
